She sits on the front of the real right bench cushion, hips and both thighs supported, torso tilted a little forward and diagonally toward the room, shoulders asymmetrical due to the fret arm. The gray skirt drapes modestly over two supported thighs. Both boots have heel/forefoot contact, no knee through another thigh, crossed anatomy, floating pelvis, huge stretched legs or hidden foot. Her torso and arm actions must express actual bass playing, not a book swapped for a guitar.
This is a project-original informal music interaction, not a claim of an official instrument brand/model or real concert. No stage, amp, mic stand, phone, book, cup, readable score, logo or added furniture. Keep a whole wide room, empty original chair and clear floor passage.
